generatedSkill.name: Cited web research
generatedSkill.objective: Answer a research question from several web sources and attribute every important claim.
procedure: Restate the research question and list the aspects it needs covered.
Write several search queries, one per aspect.
Compare what the sources say and note where they conflict.
Search again for an aspect that no source covers.
Write the answer and attach the source URL to each important claim.

toolUsageGuidance.whenToUse: For every aspect of the research question.
toolUsageGuidance.guidance: Send one focused query per aspect; keep each result's url with its content, and search again when an aspect has no source.

constraints: Never state a fact that no retrieved source supports.
completionCriteria: The answer addresses the research question.
Every important claim carries a source URL.
